mechanism: Keep one subject and assembly station spatially fixed while a visibly larger external operator installs components in a deliberate order. Alternate local contact proof with repeated whole-subject state checks so every addition accumulates. Reserve fine calibration for after the main silhouette is complete, then require one integrated movement audition that demonstrates all installed parts together before the final hold.

invariants.rule: Establish one stable subject, assembly station and unmodified baseline.
invariants.purpose: Provides a state reference for every addition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a baseline, later parts cannot be attributed to the operator.

invariants.rule: Install major components one at a time and return to a whole-subject check after each stage.
invariants.ablation_failure: A montage of close-ups hides whether parts coexist.

invariants.rule: Use local contact proof for fine calibration only after the primary structure is complete.
invariants.purpose: Separates structural assembly from detail tuning.
invariants.ablation_failure: Early fine detail weakens the state ladder.

invariants.rule: Complete all small functional or decorative components before testing motion.
invariants.purpose: Prevents the audition from introducing unexplained changes.

invariants.rule: End with one integrated movement audition and a held complete state.
invariants.purpose: Proves the assembled system works together.
invariants.ablation_failure: A static beauty pose cannot validate integration.

slots.name: sound_family

instantiations.concept: On an original orbital workshop bench, two large robotic service gloves assemble a palm-sized weather automaton: walking base, folded wing plates, visor, pressure wand and sensor rings. Each connection is shown locally and checked in full figure; the complete automaton walks, opens both wings and measures one airflow stream before holding.
